evidence: native/src/decoration/dependencies.rs View::read_column locks its local map for every scalar material/height cache hit.
C34 enabled diagnostic observed36665808 view_column_cached_reads and1848793 loads,63012 anchors. C24 removed Arc ownership traffic on hits but retained this mutex.
C34 sampled execution lists View::material among the largest native self samples; counts are not wall-time shares.
constraints: Own new worktree and PR from then-current origin/main.
No global cache, unsafe code, speculative replay, truncation or root reordering.
A bounded direct cache must use exact coordinate keys; collisions retain the original unbounded fallback. Use immutable OnceLock cells so returned references remain valid.
Do not hold the fallback map lock while recursively building prior columns. Preserve error propagation and diagnostic accounting.
Measure allocation/zeroing overhead; benchmark small sizes as prototypes, not a runtime tuning requirement.
Compare complete NBT to original+C5+preceding merged baseline including reverse/concurrent/custom/Overworld.
